description: Improve the internal structure of existing code without changing its observable behaviour. Use when the user says "refactor this", "clean this up", "simplify this", "extract a method/class", "rename for clarity", "reduce this duplication", or "tidy this without changing behaviour". The defining constraint is behaviour preservation: the tests pass before and after, and the public contract is unchanged. Do NOT use to add or change behaviour, fix a bug, or build a feature (that is create-code-generation), and do NOT use to delete dead code as the primary goal.
